passages.context: Homily 1: complete numbered section 1, from its opening call to Paul through the exposition of those calling on the Lord; the preceding unexpounded quotation of verse 3 is excluded. Complete selected consecutive source unit read against the exact held digital expression with adjacent lemmata/section markers checked; no whole-homily, facsimile or original-Greek inspection is claimed.
passages.notes: The explicit body preserves the historical translation’s spelling, punctuation, verse/section labels and inline lexical glosses, changing only wrapping whitespace and omitting numeric footnote calls. Separate editorial footnote prose remains in the complete segment and is not attributed to Chrysostom here. The passage’s locus is the enclosing homily number; this context and the exact line range identify its smaller natural unit. The constituent title credits Talbot W. Chambers with revision and additional notes (61-79). The Oxford preface credits Hubert Kestell Cornish and John Medley with the translation (173-176), and identifies the numbered Benedictine sections (171-173).
